title: LinkedIn Company Scraper Input
description: Enrich public LinkedIn company pages or run a recurring company watchlist. Direct URLs are the most precise option. Reuse the same watchlist name to receive changes, deltas, alerts, and bounded observation history.

companyUrls.title: LinkedIn Company URLs
companyUrls.description: List of LinkedIn company profile URLs to scrape directly. Example: https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/

companyNames.title: Company Names to Look Up
companyNames.description: Company names to resolve to their public LinkedIn company page. Each name is matched to one company. Well-known names resolve reliably; ambiguous or heavily abbreviated names may not, so direct URLs remain the most precise option.

maxResults.title: Max Company Name Lookups
maxResults.description: Maximum number of company names to look up in one run. Company URLs you list explicitly are always scraped and are not limited by this value.

accessMode.title: Access Strategy
accessMode.description: Direct first minimizes platform cost and uses the configured proxy only when public access fails. Proxy first skips the free direct attempt.

watchlistName.title: Watchlist Name
watchlistName.description: A stable private name for recurring comparisons. Run the same companies with the same name to get field changes, follower and employee deltas, and history.

followerChangePercent.title: Follower Change Alert (%)
followerChangePercent.description: Create a signal when the public follower count changes by at least this percentage.

employeeChangePercent.title: Employee Change Alert (%)
employeeChangePercent.description: Create a signal when the public employee count changes by at least this percentage.

historyLimit.title: Observations Kept Per Company
historyLimit.description: Bounded private history retained for each company and watchlist.

generateMarkdownReport.title: Create Markdown Report
generateMarkdownReport.description: Save a concise, shareable company-change report in the run's key-value store.

generateCsvReport.title: Create CSV Change Report
generateCsvReport.description: Save a spreadsheet-ready company-change report in the run's key-value store.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Fallback proxy settings. Residential US is the reliable default when direct public access is blocked.
